result.paraphrase:
Abstract
The oral care of patients with periodontal disease primarily relies on clinical examination. However, the limited number of medical staff makes it impossible to provide detailed oral health education to many patients within a restricted time or to offer proper and effective oral nursing methods. In this study, we proposed a new artificial intelligence-based approach for diagnosing chronic gingivitis using a multichannel gray-level co-occurrence matrix (MGLCM) and a particle swarm optimization neural network (PSONN). Different training algorithms were also used as comparison groups. The dataset comprises 800 images: 400 chronic gingivitis images and 400 healthy gingiva images. The results show that the MGLCM method with PSONN as classifier achieved specificity, sensitivity, precision, accuracy, and F1 score of 78.17%, 78.23%, 78.24%, 78.20%, and 78.17%, respectively. The combination of MGLCM and PSONN is more accurate and efficient than NBC, WN+SVM, ELM, and CLAHE+ELM.
